# agent-instruction-load-audit

Proves at runtime which instruction files a coding-agent harness actually loaded, in what precedence, and which failed silently, for Claude Code, Codex CLI, pi, GitHub Copilot CLI and similar. Covers a static inventory with frontmatter, symlink and shadowing checks, then a canary-marker probe run in a fresh session, and reports each file as loaded, not loaded, shadowed or unverified. Use when asked which CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, rules, memory or skills an agent really loaded, why an instruction is being ignored, whether a skill will load, or to verify instruction files after a change. Do NOT use to write or restructure AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md content (use ai-coding-agent-setup), or to audit the content of a project's documentation.

- **Entry point:** [SKILL.md](SKILL.md)
- **Version:** 1.0.0
- **Licence:** Apache-2.0, see [LICENSE](LICENSE)

## Install

Copy this directory into either skills location, then start a new session:

```bash
cp -r agent-instruction-load-audit ~/.claude/skills/       # personal, all projects
cp -r agent-instruction-load-audit .claude/skills/         # this project only
```

For Claude Desktop, zip the directory and upload it under
Settings, Capabilities, Skills. Released builds attach a ready-made zip.

## Bundled files

Loaded on demand, not up front. SKILL.md routes to them.

- `references/harness-load-rules.md`
- `references/runtime-probe.md`
- `scripts/audit_instruction_files.py`
- `scripts/test_audit_instruction_files.py`
